name: Rusty Sword
description: 90-degree swing arc. Moderate reach, moderate speed.

name: Bone Dagger
description: 60-degree arc. Fastest swing speed. Short reach, low damage.

name: Broad Axe
description: 120-degree arc. Long reach. Hard hits, slow swing.

name: Flame Blade
description: Leaves lava pools on swing. Built-in Lava Emitter.

name: Throwing Knife
description: Single fast straight-flying projectile. Quick cooldown, long lifetime.

name: Fire Orb
description: Slow short-lived orb. Highest single-shot ranged damage.

name: Spread Shot
description: Fires 3 projectiles in a 30-degree fan. Weak per bolt, heavy total if all land.

name: Boss Staff
description: Single bolt with subtle spread. Longest projectile lifetime.

name: Willowblade
description: Quick swings on tap. Charged thrust lands a guaranteed critical.

name: Flame Sword
description: Critical hits set foes on fire. Leaves lava pools behind the wielder.

name: Frost Sword
description: Wide arc. Critical hits freeze enemies solid.

name: Qinggang Light Sword
description: Alternating up-and-down swings.

name: Blood Blade
description: Full charge unleashes a rapid burst of lunging swings that carry the wielder forward.

name: Tao Sword
description: Heavy greatsword. Slow wide swings.

name: Dragon Fang
description: Three fast thrusts per use. Skewers straight ahead without slowing movement.

name: Heavenly Sword
description: Wide frost-touched swings. Critical hits freeze enemies solid.

name: Grand Knight's Sword
description: Three-hit combo: two arcing slashes, then a thrust. High damage up close.

name: Deep Dark Blade
description: Forward spin into a grounded thrust.

name: Broadsword
description: Wide swing across everything ahead. Holding the attack slows movement.

name: Executioner
description: Tap for a single chop. Charge for up to two spinning slashes. Short reach, quick wind-up.

name: Void Sword
description: Charge drags nearby enemies inward. Release cuts them in a single arc.

name: Caliburn
description: Long reach. 35% critical chance.

name: Phantom Blade
description: Upward slash into a forward thrust. The edge passes through enemy guard.

name: Iron Mace
description: Blunt head. Crushes armor, stuns on impact. Slow swing.

name: Rapier
description: Thrusting blade. Very fast, narrow reach, 30% crit chance.

name: Bone Cleaver
description: Wide front arc. Low damage per hit, hits all foes ahead.

name: War Scythe
description: Sweeps a full 300-degree arc. Hits flanks and rear.

name: Twin Daggers
description: Strikes twice per swing. Low damage per hit, high total output.

name: Obsidian Greatsword
description: Cleaves terrain. Slowest, heaviest swing. 5% crit chance, 3x crit multiplier.

name: Venom Fang Blade
description: Long darting lunge. Very fast, light damage.

name: Tide Caller
description: Critical hits apply Wet status. Vulnerable to freeze and shock.

name: Cinder Brand
description: 25% crit chance. Each crit sets the target on fire.

name: Glacier Edge
description: Heavy blade. Slow swing. 20% chance to freeze on critical.

name: Thunder Katana
description: 35% crit chance, highest of any weapon.

name: Gravedigger's Spade
description: Digs through terrain. Doubles as a blunt weapon.

name: Reaper's Glaive
description: Long reach. Kills restore health.

name: Berserker's Axe
description: Damage increases as health decreases.

name: Mirror Blade
description: Swings deflect incoming projectiles.

name: Whirlwind Blade
description: Charged spin strikes every foe around the wielder.

name: Quake Hammer
description: Charged slam sends a shockwave outward, flinging back nearby enemies.

name: Soul Reaver
description: Kills grant a stacking damage bonus. Stacks decay when combat ends.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: Single bolt pierces through multiple enemies in a line.

name: Scatter Blunderbuss
description: Wide cone of pellets. Powerful up close, weak at range.

name: Arc Railgun
description: Charged rail-shot. Pierces everything in a line. Longer charge deals more damage.

name: Flame Lobber
description: Lobs pots that shatter into lava pools on impact.

name: Frost Repeater
description: Fastest fire rate. Weak per shot, but applies freeze.

name: Venom Spitter
description: Spits globs that leave caustic pools on impact.

name: Tesla Gun
description: Lightning bolts that chain from foe to foe.

name: Chakram Launcher
description: Spinning chakram flies out and returns. Hits twice per throw.

name: Seeker Launcher
description: Missiles that track and chase targets around cover.

name: Hailstorm Bow
description: Single pull fans into a volley of arrows across a wide area.
